title: Design: No-charge work order header shows the No Charge badge
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a regular customer (not flagged), with one asset.
  • Have a new work order for the regular customer, with one labor line (1.0 h) and one stock part with a cost, converted to No Charge with the category Goodwill, made for this test.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow2-05-03-no-charge-work-order.png, iwo-happy-23-23-after-the-convert.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "No Charge" badge sits next to the status, in a different style from the Internal badge.
  • The header card has the orange outline and light orange background.
  • Lines show cost and hours with no prices; the category name is not shown anywhere on the work order.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R3: “The work order header shows one badge next to the status: "Internal" for an internal work order, "No Charge" for a no-charge work order (a different style from Internal), in the desktop and the mobile header. It is the only mark on the work order: the customer card on the detail page shows no badge and no category. On the detail page the header card of an internal or no-charge work order has an orange outline and a light orange background (a new style for the header card, on desktop and on the mobile header; the design authority names the token), so the work order is recognised at a glance; there is no hint sentence under the header. The category of a no-charge work order is not shown on the work order; it is in the Change category dialog, on the NO CHARGE document and in the report (S2-R16). A billable work order that carries no-charge lines carries no badge and no header style; the line carries the mark (Story 12).”
  • S2-R16: “It is not shown on the work order detail or in lists; the badge is the only mark there.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: pages "Flow 2 · No charge on a customer's work order" / "Happy flow v6", boards "03 No charge work order" (Flow 2 · No charge on a customer's work order), "23 After the convert" (Happy flow v6).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • iwo-flow2-05-03-no-charge-work-order.png
  • iwo-happy-23-23-after-the-convert.png

The design's own words:

  • “No Charge”
  • “$180.00 cost”

Difference: the design draws No Charge in the Internal badge style (IWO-D15) and no orange header (IWO-D14), settled by S2-R3.
